stem.text: A student mixes $25.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.350\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium hydroxide solution with $25.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.350\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid. The temperature increases by $2.5\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. No heat is lost to the surroundings.
The final mixture has a specific heat capacity of $4.2\,\text{J cm}^{-3}\text{K}^{-1}$.
What is the molar enthalpy change for the reaction?
